title: Microlux DW Illuminator Helps Detect Caries, Cracks, and Biofilm
html:
The Microlux DW Illuminator allows for a more precise diagnostic examination. It uses dual wavelengths to detect abnormal conditions quickly and safely, without X-rays or UV light. 

You can visualize caries and cracks with the visible white-light transillumination mode and bacteria and plaque with the fluorescence illumination mode.

It can help detect the following:

  • Caries
  • White spot lesions
  • Bacteria in caries (S. mutans)
  • Biofilm
  • Cracks
  • Demineralization
  • Composite vs. tooth structure
  • Plaque

References are available at www.addent.com.
